frc-cso-pkg.serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The ElevenLabs Platform is a cloud-based AI voice and audio service that enables organizations to generate, transform, and deploy AI-produced speech and audio at scale. The FedRAMP Class A certification scope of the offering comprises three services — Text to Speech, Speech to Text, and Agents — delivered via the ElevenLabs API and the ElevenAgents platform, and applies only when the services are operated in Zero Retention Mode (ZRM), in which customer inputs and outputs are not retained and only system and audit data is persisted. All services share a common identity and access management layer, workspace-based multi-tenancy, and a unified data plane, with capabilities accessible to enterprise workspace administrators and developers integrating via API.
frc-cso-pkg.serviceProperties.trustCenter.repository: The ElevenLabs Compliance Repository is a collection of documents that are used to demonstrate that the ElevenLabs Platform is compliant with a number of different requirements, including the requirements of the FedRAMP program.
frc-cso-pkg.serviceProperties.secureConfigurationGui: Public secure configuration guidance for the ElevenLabs Platform, covering encryption in transit and at rest, cryptographic module validation, identity and access management (SSO and SCIM), API credential security, data protection (including Zero Retention Mode and data residency), monitoring and audit logging, webhook security, and recommended configuration for regulated workloads.
frc-cso-pkg.assessor.name: No assessor engaged, Class A self-attestation, independent assessment planned for the B/C/D track, and the ID is a schema-format placeholder
frc-cso-pkg.certifiedServices[].serviceName: Text to Speech; Speech to Text; Agents
frc-cso-pkg.certifiedServices[].serviceDescription: AI speech synthesis via the ElevenLabs API, converting text to natural-sounding audio across 32–70+ languages depending on model, with Python and TypeScript SDKs. Included in the FedRAMP Class A certification scope only when operated in Zero Retention Mode (ZRM): customer inputs and outputs are processed but not retained.; AI transcription via the ElevenLabs API, with word-level timestamps, speaker diarization, and entity detection across 90+ languages. Included in the FedRAMP Class A certification scope only when operated in Zero Retention Mode (ZRM): customer inputs and outputs are processed but not retained.; ElevenAgents: a platform for designing, deploying, and operating real-time conversational voice agents, accessible through the elevenlabs.io dashboard and programmatically via the ElevenLabs API, conducting low-latency bidirectional voice conversations over WebRTC or telephony channels. Included in the FedRAMP Class A certification scope only when operated in Zero Retention Mode (ZRM); optional customer-enabled external integrations (third-party LLM providers, telephony) are outside the certified configuration and disabled by default for federal use.
frc-cso-pkg.thirdPartyInformationResources.certified: Underlying FedRAMP-certified (High) cloud infrastructure and platform services (GCP) hosting the entire ElevenLabs trust boundary; inherit IaaS/PaaS controls via the GCP CRM.; FedRAMP-certified (Moderate) cloud infrastructure and platform services (AWS US East/West regions) supporting portions of the ElevenLabs trust boundary; inherit IaaS/PaaS controls via the AWS Customer Responsibility Matrix. Note: applies to the commercial AWS US East/West authorization (AGENCYAMAZONEW); AWS GovCloud (US) is a separate High package (F1603047866) not currently used.
frc-cso-pkg.thirdPartyInformationResources.nonCertif: Managed NoSQL document database supporting application and workspace data for the offering, deployed in US regions. The commercial MongoDB Atlas environment is not FedRAMP certified; MongoDB Atlas for Government (FR2122150307) is a separate, physically distinct authorized environment not used by this offering.

frc-cso-pkg.serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Partos is an AI-native operating system for the U.S. aerospace and defense supply chain, unifying prime contractors, suppliers, and sub-tier vendors in a single Government Community Cloud environment on AWS GovCloud (US). Partos accelerates supplier onboarding and vetting with continuous KYB, KYC, AML, and OFAC screening and compliance monitoring across ITAR, EAR export controls, and DFARS. It delivers end-to-end, multi-tier supply chain risk visibility and active risk management, and orchestrates domestic and international supplier payments—ACH, RTP, and wires—with compliance tracing preserved throughout. The platform leverages export control regulatory frameworks (including ITAR, EAR, and CUI) to automatically enforce data access boundaries. Access is dynamically controlled based on variables like nationality and geographic location, ensuring continuous compliance at every layer. A unified data ontology and pipeline layer powers Partos AI, a multi-agent, multimodal system in which specialized agents collaborate to answer questions and act across the entire supply chain. Partos AI works both reactively and proactively—agents operate as an extension of your team, monitoring, surfacing risks, and advancing work 24/7 rather than only responding on request. Partos AI is model-agnostic (open-source and proprietary), extensible via a no-code workflow builder and REST, WebSocket, SSE, and MCP interfaces, and embeddable in any enterprise application. It supports multi- and single-tenancy, multiple IdPs and SSO, SCIM provisioning, and granular role-, group-, and permission-based access. Customers retain full ownership and exportability of their data and the AI's memory.

frc-cso-pkg.certifiedServices[].serviceDescription: AI phone agents that answer inbound calls and place outbound calls, hold natural spoken conversations, and act on what the caller needs. Each agent follows a configurable conversation pathway, a decision tree that interprets the caller’s intent and then routes the call or takes an action such as scheduling, sending follow-ups, taking payments, answering questions from an approved knowledge base, or escalating to a person. Speech-to-text, reasoning, and text-to-speech all run on Bland’s own models inside Bland’s boundary.; Programmatic two-way text messaging driven by the same pathway logic as voice agents. Agents send and respond to messages for notifications, reminders, status updates, and structured question-and-answer flows, triggering the same actions as a voice agent, such as scheduling, follow-ups, and record updates, over text rather than a call.; Web and in-app chat agents that run on the same conversation pathways and actions as voice and SMS, embedded in an agency’s web properties for self-service. Chat shares the rule sets, knowledge, and integrations of the other channels, so a constituent gets the same answers and outcomes no matter how they reach out.
